title: Inside Zendaya’s Disney Reunion on ‘Euphoria’ With Kadeem Hardison: “She’s a Little Less Goofy”
summary: Hardison talks about his wild 'Euphoria' ride, the homage to his breakout role from more than three decades ago and working with Zendaya all grown up after 'K.C. Undercover': "I knew she was good when we were doing 'K.C.,' but I didn't know she had that kind of depth."
